requirement.statement: C# OM SHALL optionally resolve canonical behavior binding ids to bounded Jint callbacks outside Om.Core while preserving typed runtime, readiness and transaction semantics.

case.given: A canonical catalog references scripts for every BehaviorCatalogCallbackSlot
case.when: The Jint provider builds callback bindings and RequireReady import runs
case.then: Every exact binding id SHALL map by ordinal equality to the slot's required BehaviorCallbackBindingSet delegate type and become ready

case.given: A catalog binding id has no script definition
case.then: The slot SHALL remain absent with a structured diagnostic and existing unresolved or RequireReady behavior SHALL apply

case.given: One binding id is reused by incompatible callback shapes such as action handler and interceptor handler
case.then: It SHALL reject the conflict deterministically before import effects

case.given: Native typed and script-generated callbacks are supplied together
case.then: Both SHALL retain exact binding identity without changing native callback semantics, and same-id merge conflicts SHALL be diagnostics before effects

case.given: A script uses an allowed property, neighbor, write, link or parent-action capability for its callback kind
case.then: The call SHALL use the existing OM context and preserve cancellation and action transaction scope

case.given: A constraint, validator, computed or action script returns a value
case.then: Only the documented JSON-shaped typed result SHALL be accepted and raw CLR objects SHALL be rejected

case.given: An action script calls the allowlisted parent-action host method
case.then: The host SHALL return those specs to the child script without auto-applying them, so only the child's returned mutation list is applied by the existing action pipeline

case.given: A script or async host call fails after earlier action/interceptor/mutation effects
case.when: The action aborts or cancellation fires
case.then: Existing C# transactional rollback semantics SHALL restore entity and relation state and no late host continuation SHALL publish effects

case.given: Scripts mutate global JavaScript state or run concurrently
case.then: No mutable engine/global state SHALL leak between invocations

case.given: A script attempts CLR, filesystem, network, module-loader or unlisted host access
case.then: The capability SHALL be absent or denied without exposing raw runtime objects

case.given: A script loops, recurses, allocates excessively or exceeds its statement budget
case.when: A configured limit is reached or unsupported by the pinned Jint version
case.then: Execution SHALL stop with a stable binding-aware limit diagnostic, or unsupported memory-limit configuration SHALL fail before execution

case.given: The caller cancels before or during script or async host execution
case.then: The callback SHALL terminate as cancellation and SHALL not publish later effects

case.given: Compilation, execution, host invocation or result conversion fails
case.then: The stable code, binding id, slot and phase SHALL be present while full source and secrets remain absent
Jint SHALL be pinned only in the adapter and Om.Core SHALL remain engine-free with no script serialization schema
